name: Short link, counter-rotating — lower link drives
note: Counter-rotating four-bar: the lower link (MP-FP) carries the shock eye SE and the upper link (SP-LP) turns the other way. The rocker is 70 mm, held at that floor for a real part (the checker would accept 35 mm but that is not buildable). Lower link and coupler are long (MP-FP about 288 mm), so this is not a true short link.
